title: SUBSIDY STEP 1: consumers persist as basal food descends 0.25 -> 0.05 on the paying-graze config?

identity.note: The probe always ran from the current checkout. A historical arm spec applied here is a settings replay, not a reproduction of its original figure.

preregistration.hypothesis: Step 1 restored paying grazing (18/18 flux) while the 0.25 basal rain still supplies ~90%+ of input. Stepping the rain down 5x should shift the income base toward producers/grazing without killing consumers; the graze link (now paying) is what carries them through the descent.
preregistration.prediction: cons > 0 on at least 12/18 seeds at tick 6000 (machine criterion below) AND grazeEnergy > 0 sustained on at least 12/18 (human-read from B/D lines: the verifier has no graze metric). Coexistence NOT predicted.
preregistration.falsification: FALSIFIED if cons = 0 on 7 or more of 18 seeds: the cut outran the link — hold the subsidy at 0.25, do not descend further, return to link/viability work. Separately, if consumers persist but grazeEnergy = 0 on >=7/18, the descent re-silenced the link and the config is incoherent: stop, do not interpret persistence as success.
preregistration.notPredicted: Endpoint guild composition, coexistence rates, capture shares, and per-win sizes. Further descent steps (0.01, 0) are separate arms, registered only if this one passes.
confoundsControlled: Same 18-seed panel, horizon, engine as graze-link; the ONLY difference is basalFoodPerCell 0.25 -> 0.05
Matched comparison against the archived graze-link run isolates the subsidy effect
conservation enforced per seed at 0.5%; a seed above it fails the run rather than reporting

criteria.statement: consumers > 0 at tick 6000 on at least 12/18 seeds
